Tap a scenario to run it. Tap the ⋮ on it (or long-press) to manage: built-in presets can be viewed and copied; your own scenarios can be edited, copied or deleted.

A scenario is a preset analysis plan: it tells the agent what to look for in this capture and which tools to use.
• Run: tap a scenario chip to start that analysis.
• Manage: tap the ⋮ on a chip, or long-press it. Built-in presets only offer View details and Copy as duplicate; your own scenarios can be edited, copied or deleted. “New scenario” creates one from scratch.
• Built-in lock: scenarios you create are saved on this device only and never affect the built-in presets.
